name: Add Cushion
detail: A cube-shaped cushion acquired from "Lady Reines's Case Files." You might get yelled at if you sit on it.

name: Archer Monument
detail: A monument in glory of the Archer class.

name: Archer Piece
detail: A piece signifying the Archer class.

name: Arrowhead of Malice
detail: An arrowhead that has bathed in blood, sin, and corruption. It is said to carry a curse that invites disaster.

name: Ash of Remembrance
detail: A tiny bottle which contains something resembling burnt-out ashes. Proof of a vow that should never be forgotten.

name: Assassin Monument
detail: A monument in glory of the Assassin class.

name: Assassin Piece
detail: A piece signifying the Assassin class.

name: Astrolabe of Faraway Adventures
detail: Ancient astronomical observation equipment acquired from "'Fate/Requiem' Board Games of the Apocalypse." It acts like a guidepost to lead one into the unknown.

name: Aurora Steel
detail: A piece of divine steel that glistens like the flickering aurora. The Valkyries from Norse mythology are said to have soared through the heavens wearing armor made of this steel.

name: B Pellet
detail: Fuel for Mecha Eli-chan, obtained during "Halloween Strike! Demonic Climb - Himeji Castle War." A vivid bloodred marshmallow. It looks delicious.

name: Ball of Rainbow Thread
detail: A ball of thread that shines like a captivating rainbow in sunlight.

name: Bell-Ringing Branch
detail: Obtained during "Summer! Ocean! Pioneering! FGO Summer 2018." A branch of the world tree infused with concentrated mana. When shaken, a mysterious sound like a bell ringing is made.

name: Berserker Monument
detail: A monument in glory of the Berserker class.

name: Berserker Piece
detail: A piece signifying the Berserker class.

name: Biten's Dragon Gem
detail: A gem that harbors the power of a dragon that flies through the heavens, acquired from "GUDAGUDA Final Honnoji 2021." The dragon of Echigo soars through the nation once again.

name: Black Beast Grease
detail: A fatty tissue collected from the skin of a soul-eating beast. By repeatedly refining it through distillation and purification, it turns into a high-quality magical resource.

name: Bucket of Chicken
detail: Tons of chicken, needed for any Christmas party, obtained during "Almost Weekly Santa Alter."

name: Caster Monument
detail: A monument in glory of the Caster class.

name: Caster Piece
detail: A piece signifying the Caster class.

name: Celtic Training Gear
detail: Sétanta's favorite training gear, acquired from "Spiral Proof World, Lilim Harlot - A Rose Without Ovation." Taking good care of your tools is part of bettering yourself, right?

name: Ceremonial Sword of Twilight
detail: A sword used only during special ceremonies. It can stand as testament to a moment of glory, or irredeemable sins.

name: Claw of Chaos
detail: Those wounded by this claw become prisoners of chaos.

name: Cosmo Guitar
detail: You feel like you'll unite the universe if you play this rad-looking guitar! Acquired from "Bedazzled! Grail Concert!"

name: Crown of Silvery Light
detail: A crown brimming with the radiance of moonlight. Granted to those who dedicate themselves to serving the gods.

name: Crystal Ball
detail: A crystal ball emitting bright light, obtained during "Revival: Fate/Accel Zero Order - LAP_2"

name: Crystallized Lore
detail: A highly pure crystal of magic created when human history crosses a stream of Mana. It can be said that it is the ingredient for materializing Heroic Spirits.

name: Cursed Beast Gallstone
detail: A stone whose curse fermented in the innards of a hexed beast. It continues to release a strong curse that will never fade.

name: Deadly Poisonous Needle
detail: It is said that anyone who is infected by this poison will not die immediately, but experience multiple deaths until their soul itself rots away.

name: Divine Leyline Spiritron
detail: A special Spiritron shrouded in divinity, flowing through a leyline created by the gods themselves.

name: Dragon Fang
detail: The fang of a dragon. Dragon Tooth Warriors are created using these fangs.

name: Dragon Orb
detail: A orb with the power of a dragon obtained during "Halloween Comeback! Super☆Ghouls 'n Pumpkins - The Seeds of Adventure." It resonates with courage, and brings out the hidden power of the hero Elidrum. Elisabeth still doesn't know that Elidrum is her registered adventurer name.

name: Dragon's Reverse Scale
detail: A scale that grew upside-down under a dragon's chin.

name: Egg of Truth
detail: A sacred egg that is said to contain the truth of the world. Its shell is so tough that no being can break it.

name: Eternal Gear
detail: Dream of an eternal machine. A gear that spins forever once it starts turning.

name: Eternal Ice
detail: Ice that does not melt, even at room temperature. Some see a lovely crystalline flower, but those with no appreciation of beauty see only a piece of ice.

name: Ether Converger
detail: A light-gathering device that uses a Photonic Crystal from the Atlas Institute to store the energy of light indefinitely.

name: Evil Bone
detail: Ominous bones wielding curses.

name: Flaming Oni Lantern Plant
detail: A lantern plant pod that is so hot to the touch it feels as though it were enveloped in the very flames of hell.

name: Flower of the End
detail: A phantom that captures the final form of a flower that once bloomed in all its beauty.

name: Fool's Chain
detail: A chain created to bind down transient souls into this world, keeping them from ascending to heaven.

name: Forbidden Page
detail: A page which nobody should ever read. Usually mixed in as the first or last page.

name: Fragment of a Twinkling Star
detail: A strange ore shaped like a twinkling star that fell from the night sky.

name: Fruit of Eternity
detail: Any who consume this fruit become immortal, but at a price. Those who accept its boon also become servants of the gods for eternity.

name: Gem of Archer
detail: A bright stone glimmering with the power of an Archer.

name: Gem of Assassin
detail: A bright stone glimmering with the power of an Assassin.

name: Gem of Berserker
detail: A bright stone glimmering with the power of a Berserker.

name: Gem of Caster
detail: A bright stone glimmering with the power of a Caster.

name: Gem of Lancer
detail: A bright stone glimmering with the power of a Lancer.

name: Gem of Rider
detail: A bright stone glimmering with the power of a Rider.

name: Gem of Saber
detail: A bright stone glimmering with the power of a Saber.

name: Genius Egg
detail: A mechanical egg, acquired from "Chaldea Summer Adventure!" What will hatch from it? Knowledge from the future, or wisdom from the past?

name: Ghost Lantern
detail: Lantern that uses souls as fuel to burn.

name: Giant's Ring
detail: A ring that is far too massive for a human to wear. Colored with legend and fantasy, it reminds one of the prosperity of ages past.

name: Gilles de Rais Doll
detail: A cute, but creepy doll gained from "The Little Santa Alter - Christmas 2018"

name: Golden Bear Lighter
detail: Obtained during "The Great Tale of Demons: Onigashima." It is decorated with a golden bear, a one-of-a-kind golden lighter.

name: Golden Cauldron
detail: A golden cauldron used since ancient times in magecraft rituals and alchemy.

name: Golden Reed
detail: An item offered by the people to Ishtar to wish for a fruitful harvest, acquired from "Dead Heat Summer Race!"

name: Golden Skull
detail: A stunning golden skull accessory! Obtained at "GUDAGUDA Honnoji."

name: Great Knight Medal
detail: A medal honoring a great knight's loyalty and merit.

name: Great Tengu Mask
detail: A Mt. Kurama tengu mask acquired from "Farewell to Kamakura - Little Big Tengu."

name: Heart Bracelet
detail: A bracelet obtained during "Magical Girl Cruise - Prisma Codes." The heart-shaped charm is a cute accent.

name: Heart of the Foreign God
detail: The heart of a savage demi-god. A god is a god, even if it's a fake. Its heartbeat emits many curses.

name: Homunculus Baby
detail: The body of a young homunculus before a soul is written into it.

name: Idol Cinderella Shoes
detail: Vicious-looking glass slippers acquired from "Halloween Rising!"

name: Kaientai Banner
detail: Ascension Material A red and white striped banner, acquired during GUDAGUDA Legend of the Imperial Capital Grail. A ship's emblem of the Kaientai, established by Ryouma. The Kaientai was an organization that received funding from their patrons to conduct trade, similar to a joint-stock company in modern times. Ryouma's dream was to eventually conduct foreign trade on a global scale, but his ambition was never fulfilled. Oryou's dream of becoming a beautiful and competent secretary also never came true.

name: Kukulcan Mask
detail: A spare of Santa/Samba's lucha mask, acquired from "Christmas 2020: Samba Night, Holy Night". Wear this, and you might become Santa too!

name: Ladle Wand
detail: A miraculous ladle, acquired from "Christmas 2023 - The Making of a Christmas Party!"

name: Lamp of Dedication
detail: An old-fashioned hand lamp, acquired from "Christmas 2021: Nightingale's Christmas Carol". In the dark of night, the lamp casts its gentle illumination over the sleeping children.

name: Lamp of Evil-Sealing
detail: A fascinating lamp that is said to have sealed in an elemental with tremendous magical energy.

name: Lancer Monument
detail: A monument in glory of the Lancer class.

name: Lancer Piece
detail: A piece signifying the Lancer class.

name: Leaf of Remembrance
detail: Ascension Material A linden tree leaf acquired from Apocrypha/Inheritance of Glory. The discoloration on it is a stain from dragon's blood.

name: M51 Ticket
detail: A ticket that allows you to request the services of the Saika clan for a job, acquired from "Full Speed Ahead! Kawanakajima 24 Hours GUDAGUDA Super Goryoukaku." When in need, call M51.

name: Magic Gem of Archer
detail: A bright stone glimmering with the great power of an Archer.

name: Magic Gem of Assassin
detail: A bright stone glimmering with the great power of an Assassin.

name: Magic Gem of Berserker
detail: A bright stone glimmering with the great power of a Berserker.

name: Magic Gem of Caster
detail: A bright stone glimmering with the great power of a Caster.

name: Magic Gem of Lancer
detail: A bright stone glimmering with the great power of a Lancer.

name: Magic Gem of Rider
detail: A bright stone glimmering with the great power of a Rider.

name: Magic Gem of Saber
detail: A bright stone glimmering with the great power of a Saber.

name: Magifender Wand
detail: A toy replica of the wand wielded by Magifender Girls, acquired from "The Land of Mystique, Oniland!"

name: Meteor Horseshoe
detail: A tough horseshoe made of metal from a meteor. Even if the elements are the same, since it wasn't created on Earth, it has a special role.

name: Mizuhiki Netsuke
detail: A miniature sculpture with a traditional Japanese decorative knot, acquired from "Waxing Moon Chronicles." They are typically not attached to blades, but Iori uses this to decorate the pommel of his sword.

name: Moonlight Core
detail: A rock said to be fragments of crystallized moonlight scattered upon the earth. It contains a great deal of magical energy.

name: Mysterious Divine Wine
detail: This precious wine was brewed over a long period of time to be offered to the gods. It can intoxicate even monsters and demonic beasts.

name: Mysterious Substance RX
detail: A substance made on Planet Ranmaru, acquired from "GUDAGUDA Ryouma's Narrow Escape!" The concentrated form of Ranmanium. Supposedly tastes a lot like caramel and chocolate.

name: Mystic Gunpowder
detail: Custom made gunpowder that ignites when the user focuses magical energy into it. Since it can generate a massive amount of firepower with only a small amount of magical energy, it's widely utilized as ammunition to hunt Demonic Beasts.

name: Mystic Spinal Fluid
detail: A potion to turn an ordinary human into a mage. When injected into the spine, it creates temporary artificial Magical Circuits.

name: No. 1 Fan Ribbon
detail: A pink ribbon acquired from "Water Monsters Crisis, The Floating Island of Innocents". It proves that the bearer is the very first local fan of a certain star, and is proof of an irreplaceable memory.

name: Nostalgic Ribbon
detail: A pink ribbon obtained during "Fate/EXTRA CCC Special Event." From a red devil to a cherry blossom-colored devil.

name: Obsidian Blade
detail: A knife made from obsidian containing magical energy. It may be primitive, its cutting edge is extremely sharp.

name: Octuplet Crystals
detail: A multi-crystal created within a golem's body.

name: Phoenix Feather
detail: Feather from a sacred bird of the Orient.

name: Piece of Ranjatai
detail: Fragrant wood said to be the best and finest incense. Obtained at "GUDAGUDA Meiji Restoration." An excited Nobbu chopped some pieces off the branch stored at the Shosoin, and then gave them to Chacha when she came by to hang out. Eh? Chacha loves the tasteful container, but the little wood chips inside are more valuable? Seriously?

name: Pitch Black Quill
detail: A forbidden quill steeped in intense darkness. Blacker than the deepest night. Obtained during Servant Summer Festival!

name: Poppy Hair Ornament
detail: A sparkling hair ornament. The crimson colored flower bewitchingly adorns the ephemeral maiden's soft hair.

name: Primordial Lanugo
detail: Beast fur oddly resembling a fiercely burning fire. It is valued as a talisman to ward off evil due to its divinity.

name: Proof of Hero
detail: Proof that you've been acknowledged as a hero. Many possess it, but they aren't conscious of it so they forget.

name: Punishment Choker
detail: A simple necklace, acquired from "After Witch on the Holy Night." It was originally a measure to preserve secrets.

name: Reactor Core of Dawn
detail: A reactor core that shines as brightly as the morning sun. The mysteries of its technology are based on sage techniques, and can be explained neither by modern science nor magecraft.

name: Refined Magatama
detail: A Magatama that possesses faint life energy. A Magatama is said to be shaped like a crescent moon, a fetus, or even a soul. However, its true purpose is veiled in mystery.

name: Remnants of Madness
detail: Those who lay claim to this mysterious stone will soon be overcome by unfathomable madness.

name: Rider Monument
detail: A monument in glory of the Rider class.

name: Rider Piece
detail: A piece signifying the Rider class.

name: Saber Monument
detail: A monument in glory of the Saber class.

name: Saber Piece
detail: A piece signifying the Saber class.

name: Santa Bag
detail: A bag for Santa acquired from "The Glorious Path to Santa Claus - The Sealed Christmas Present". It's filled with presents and children's dreams.

name: Santa Bomber Hat
detail: A hat that fully covers Santa's ears, acquired from "Merry Christmas in the Snowy Field 2025."

name: Santa Mustache
detail: A splendid false mustache that looks exactly like the one Santa Claus himself sports, obtained during "Merry Christmas in the Underworld." Should one with the power to travel the stars put this on, she will transform into Santa immediately! Ho ho ho!

name: Scale of Fantasy
detail: Scales shed from fairy wings. They serve as a reagent for various magical powders.

name: Scarab of Wisdom
detail: A sacred ornament that symbolizes rebirth and regeneration. Given only to the truly wise who can solve complex problems.

name: Secret Gem of Archer
detail: A bright stone glimmering with the immense power of an Archer.

name: Secret Gem of Assassin
detail: A bright stone glimmering with the immense power of an Assassin.

name: Secret Gem of Berserker
detail: A bright stone glimmering with the immense power of a Berserker.

name: Secret Gem of Caster
detail: A bright stone glimmering with the immense power of a Caster.

name: Secret Gem of Lancer
detail: A bright stone glimmering with the immense power of a Lancer.

name: Secret Gem of Rider
detail: A bright stone glimmering with the immense power of a Rider.

name: Secret Gem of Saber
detail: A bright stone glimmering with the immense power of a Saber.

name: Seed of Yggdrasil
detail: A seed of a giant tree that symbolizes the world.

name: Serpent Jewel
detail: A jewel as if you are being stared by serpent eyes.

name: Sharp Knife
detail: Obtained during "the Garden of sinners/the Garden of Order." A knife forged by an experienced blacksmith. Usually, when you give this to someone, their mood gets better.

name: Shell of Reminiscence
detail: The shell of a clam that has lived for an eternity. When you put your ear against the aperture, you can hear the sounds of pure waves from the distant past.

name: Small Bell of Absolution
detail: The tears of sinners. A small bell that is left behind after separation.

name: Solar Hide
detail: Hide that stores sunlight and changes into various colors. Not only is it beautiful, it is also strong as steel.

name: Soundless Bell
detail: An enchanted bell made using the techniques of the sages. The sound it makes when rung is inaudible. It has a soothing effect, and can also control tractable animals such as horses.

name: Spirit Root
detail: A root where an earth elemental resides. If you plant this root onto a statue, it will soon start moving as if it were alive.

name: Stake of Wailing Night
detail: A stake driven into a corpse to prevent its reanimation. It never rusts, and retains its luster by absorbing blood. It can even pierce otherworldly beings that lurk in the dark of night.

name: Tearstone of Blood
detail: The crystal of the tear shed by a giant eyeball-like creature when it dies. A strong curse is residing within this crystal.

name: Thirty-Six Flavors of Mt. Fuji Shaved Ice
detail: Shaved ice created and inspired by the Grand Canyon, acquired from "All In! Las Vegas Championship Match". Apparently there are a total of 36 flavors.

name: Tianwei's Jade Orb
detail: A mysterious replica of a jewel that holds the power of Tianwei, the Minute Star of Heaven, acquired during "Halloween Rebellion of 108!"

name: Tsukumo Mirror
detail: A mirror that has been passed down over many years, eventually coming to house mysterious entities such as divine and evil spirits.

name: Twilight Magatama
detail: A mysterious magatama created from a special ore which can only be mined in a certain cave. It seems to be constantly emitting a strange, mysterious power.

name: Twinkle Candy
detail: Cute candy perfect for pop idol stars, obtained during "The Adventure of Singing Pumpkin Castle."

name: Universal Cube
detail: Semi-matter that can change into any form or material according to the data entered into it. It is a cube in its default condition.

name: Valkyrie Beret
detail: A replica of the berets worn by the Valkyries as part of their summer Spirit Origins, acquired from "Arctic Summer World."

name: Void's Dust
detail: Dust that disperses when hollow shadows disappear.

name: VVV Stick
detail: A durable bow that can be used as a weapon on its own, acquired from "Servant Summer Festival 2025!"

name: Warhorse's Young Horn
detail: A small horn growing on the head of a two-horned beast that is hiding within its hair. When the large horn breaks, this horn immediately grows and becomes the new horn.
